name: @roleradar/desktop

scripts.build: bash ../../scripts/build-ai-service.sh && node ../../scripts/prepare-sidecar.cjs && pnpm --filter @roleradar/api build && pnpm --filter @roleradar/api --prod deploy ./sidecar/api && pnpm --filter @roleradar/contracts build && electron-vite build && node ../../scripts/verify-electron-output.cjs && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb
scripts.build:dir: bash ../../scripts/build-ai-service.sh && node ../../scripts/prepare-sidecar.cjs && pnpm --filter @roleradar/api build && pnpm --filter @roleradar/api --prod deploy ./sidecar/api && pnpm --filter @roleradar/contracts build && electron-vite build && node ../../scripts/verify-electron-output.cjs && electron-builder --dir
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @roleradar/contracts build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit

description: A local-first desktop workspace for intelligent job discovery, application tracking, career organization, and AI-assisted search powered by local LLMs.
